# Paraswap Dispatch
> Independent reporting on Paraswap execution, routing and developer integrations.
We cover routing mechanics, execution costs, liquidity sources and contract changes.
Our reporting prioritizes on-chain evidence, reproducible comparisons and practical implications for developers.
We distinguish measured results from estimates and correct material errors visibly.
